en: A sepia-toned historical postcard depicting a grand, ornate building with a large central dome and two smaller domes on either side. There is a clock visible on the façade. The foreground shows a bustling public square with people, market stalls, and horse-drawn carriages. The architecture features detailed stonework, arches, and symmetrical windows. The location appears urban, surrounded by rows of classic European buildings. At the bottom left, the text reads 'Graz, Rathaus,' indicating the building is a town hall.
